npm_vulnerability_exceptions.reason: No patched deepmerge release exists. It is a build-time dev dependency of @sveltejs/vite-plugin-svelte and workbox-build that merges repository-owned config, never user input, and is not shipped to the browser. The only npm-suggested fix downgrades vite-plugin-pwa to 1.1.0.

The global override moves glob and its consumers (Sentry and workbox build plugins) to minimatch 11. eslint-plugin-import-x 4.17.1 imports makeRe, which minimatch 11 removed, so a scoped override keeps it on minimatch 10.2.6; npm 11 extends that pin to import-x's eslint peer tree (eslint, @eslint/config-array, typescript-estree). These are dev-only lint tools that compile globs from the repository ESLint config, never user input. Drop the scoped override once eslint-plugin-import-x supports minimatch 11.
